items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: I've been a tell about the terminal. Paul Piazza was in it. George Bracey. Louis Rodriguez... George Bracey was the leader. ... I played clown at the end of that band.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Who was in that band? Huh? Who was in the terminal band?
Oh, Lord. Poetry of George Bracey. Man Creole. Let's see what they play.
